STEP 01
1
본문과 해석
본문 + 해석 + 핵심 어휘 정리
원문 PASSAGE
1Commercial businesses aim for predictability and certainty, especially when it comes to product quality. 2But predictability and certainty are not always valued in the sporting world, especially when it comes to the delivery of professional sport competitions. 3From a spectator's perspective the sport experience is better experienced when unpredictable. 4Sport events actually depend on that unpredictability in order to attract people to the game. 5When the results of games cannot be predicted, attendances at sporting contests are likely to be higher, as are the profits of leagues. 6However, the presence of predictability also leads to significant variability in the quality of sporting performances. 7Many factors can contribute to the variability of the sport product, including the weather, player injuries, the venue, the quality of the opponents, the closeness of the scores and even the size of the crowd. 8A cricket match can be exhilarating, boring or even frustrating, but fans still have to pay the same price. 9Sport marketers may attempt to overcome this by 'improving' the product in systematic ways, such as including a star player, offering premium seating or providing other forms of entertainment and inviting facilities. 10The uncertain nature of sport contests is just one element of a total experience, although it is an important element for financial success.
전체 해석
1상업적 기업들은 특히 제품 품질에 관해서는 예측 가능성과 확실성을 목표로 한다. 2그러나 예측 가능성과 확실성이 스포츠 세계에서, 특히 프로 스포츠 경기를 제공하는 일에 관해서는 항상 가치 있게 여겨지는 것은 아니다. 3관중의 관점에서 스포츠 경험은 예측 불가능할 때 더 잘 경험된다. 4스포츠 행사는 사람들을 경기로 끌어들이기 위해 실제로 그 예측 불가능성에 의존한다. 5경기 결과를 예측할 수 없을 때, 스포츠 경기의 관중 수는 더 많아질 가능성이 높으며, 리그의 수익도 마찬가지다. 6그러나 예측 가능성의 존재(→부재) 또한 스포츠 경기력의 질에 상당한 변동성을 초래한다. 7날씨, 선수 부상, 경기장, 상대의 수준, 점수의 접전 정도, 심지어 관중의 규모까지 포함해 많은 요인이 스포츠 상품의 변동성에 기여할 수 있다. 8크리켓 경기는 짜릿하거나 지루하거나 심지어 답답할 수도 있지만, 팬들은 여전히 같은 가격을 지불해야 한다. 9스포츠 마케터들은 스타 선수를 포함시키거나, 프리미엄 좌석을 제공하거나, 다른 형태의 오락과 매력적인 시설을 제공하는 등 체계적인 방식으로 상품을 '개선'함으로써 이것을 극복하려 시도할 수 있다. 10스포츠 경기의 불확실한 본질은 총체적 경험의 한 요소일 뿐이지만, 그것은 재정적 성공을 위한 중요한 요소이다.
필수 단어
1. commercial[형]상업적인
2. predictability[명]예측 가능성
3. certainty[명]확실성
4. when it comes to[구]~에 관한 한
5. value[동]가치 있게 여기다
6. delivery[명]제공, 전달
7. spectator[명]관중, 관객
8. perspective[명]관점, 시각
9. unpredictable[형]예측 불가능한
10. depend on[구]~에 의존하다
11. attract[동]끌어들이다
12. attendance[명]관중 수, 참석
13. contest[명]경기, 시합
14. profit[명]수익, 이익
15. presence[명]존재 (→absence)
16. variability[명]변동성
17. contribute to[구]~에 기여하다
18. injury[명]부상
19. venue[명]경기장, 개최지
20. opponent[명]상대, 적수

STEP 01
1
본문과 해석
본문 + 해석 + 핵심 어휘 정리
동의어 ≈
1.commercial = business, for-profit
2.predictability = certainty, regularity
3.certainty = assurance, sureness
4.when it comes to = regarding
5.value = prize, esteem
반의어 ↔
1.commercial ↔ nonprofit
2.predictability ↔ unpredictability
3.certainty ↔ uncertainty, doubt
4.when it comes to ↔ —
5.value ↔ neglect
영영풀이
1.spectator: a person who watches an event, especially a sports game
2.attract: to pull or draw someone toward something
3.variability: the quality of being likely to change in an unexpected way
4.opponent: a person or team competing against another
5.overcome: to successfully deal with or solve a difficult problem
필수 표현
1.when it comes to: ~에 관한 한
2.depend on: ~에 의존하다
3.contribute to: ~에 기여하다
4.be likely to: ~할 가능성이 높다
5.in order to: ~하기 위해

STEP 6 영문 배열 10문항
1
Commercial businesses aim for predictability and certainty, especially when it comes to product quality.
2
But predictability and certainty are not always valued in the sporting world, especially when it comes to the delivery of professional sport competitions.
3
From a spectator's perspective the sport experience is better experienced when unpredictable.
4
Sport events actually depend on that unpredictability in order to attract people to the game.
5
When the results of games cannot be predicted, attendances at sporting contests are likely to be higher, as are the profits of leagues.
6
However, the presence of predictability also leads to significant variability in the quality of sporting performances.
7
Many factors can contribute to the variability of the sport product, including the weather, player injuries, the venue, the quality of the opponents, the closeness of the scores and even the size of the crowd.
8
A cricket match can be exhilarating, boring or even frustrating, but fans still have to pay the same price.
9
Sport marketers may attempt to overcome this by 'improving' the product in systematic ways, such as including a star player, offering premium seating or providing other forms of entertainment and inviting facilities.
10
The uncertain nature of sport contests is just one element of a total experience, although it is an important element for financial success.
